literal: On day Jihai in the seventh month, the moon transgressed the Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: July, jihai: the Moon crossed the Ghost asterism.

literal: The prognostication states: "The state will have grief."
idiomatic: National mourning is foretold.

literal: One gloss says: "Qin will have arms."
idiomatic: Another gloss cites Qin-region warfare.

literal: On day Renwu in the eighth month, the Great White transgressed the great star of the Coachman.
idiomatic: August, renwu: Venus crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star.

literal: On day Jiashen, the moon transgressed the front star of the Heart.
idiomatic: Jiashen: the Moon crossed the Heart’s forward star.

literal: The calamity lies on Yu Province.
idiomatic: The blow falls on Yu region.

literal: On day Bingxu, the moon transgressed the fifth star of the Dipper.
idiomatic: Bingxu: the Moon crossed the Dipper’s fifth star.

literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
idiomatic: Same gloss as the prior Dipper omen.

literal: On day Dinghai, the moon covered the southern star of the Ox station.
idiomatic: Dinghai: the Moon occulted the Ox lodge’s southern star.

literal: The prognostication states: "Under Heaven there will be great executions."
idiomatic: Mass executions sweep the realm.

literal: On day Yiwei, the Great White transgressed Shao Wei.
idiomatic: Yiwei: Venus crossed Shao Wei.

literal: On day Bingwu, the Great White was in Shao Wei and was seen in daytime.
idiomatic: Bingwu: Venus stood in Shao Wei yet blazed by day.

literal: On day Jiayin in the ninth month, the Great White transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: September, jiayin: Venus crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

literal: On day Dingchou, Saturn transgressed the Net.
idiomatic: Dingchou: Saturn crossed the Net.

literal: The prognostication states: "There will be border troops."
idiomatic: Frontier armies mobilize.

literal: In that year’s third month, Defender of Shixing Xu Daofu rebelled.
idiomatic: That March Shixing governor Xu Daofu rose in revolt.

literal: In the fourth month, Lu Xun raided the Xiang basin, took Baling, and led his host to press the capital region.
idiomatic: April: Lu Xun scourged Hunan, seized Baling, and drove on the capital approaches.

literal: That month, Left Director Meng Chang, fearing royal authority was not vigorous, drank poison and killed himself.
idiomatic: That month Left Director Meng Chang, despairing of the throne’s strength, took poison.

literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year, Liu Fan displayed Xu Daofu’s head; Du Huidu beheaded Lu Xun; both heads were sent to the capital.
idiomatic: Seventh year’s twelfth month: Liu Fan sent up Xu Daofu’s head while Du Huidu slew Lu Xun; both trophies reached Jiankang.

literal: In the eighth year’s sixth month, Liu Daogui died; at the time he was Inspector of Yu Province.
idiomatic: Eighth year, June: Liu Daogui died while serving as Yu inspector.

literal: In the eighth month, Empress Wang died.
idiomatic: August: Empress Wang passed away.

literal: In the ninth month, Yan Inspector Liu Fan and Left Director Xie Hun were executed in the field.
idiomatic: September: Yan inspector Liu Fan and left director Xie Hun were put to death.

literal: Liu Yu campaigned west against Liu Yi and displayed his severed head.
idiomatic: Liu Yu’s western column finished Liu Yi and paraded his head.

literal: In the twelfth month, he dispatched Yi Inspector Zhu Lingshi to campaign against Shu.
idiomatic: December: Zhu Lingshi was sent to conquer Shu.

literal: In the seventh year, fourth month, day Xinchou, Mars entered the Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: Seventh year, fourth month, xinchou: Mars entered the Ghost asterism.

literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms."
idiomatic: Qin lands see war.

literal: One gloss says: "Yong Province will have calamity."
idiomatic: Another gloss targets Yongzhou.

literal: In the sixth month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Wings.
idiomatic: June: Venus shone by day in the Wings.

literal: On day Jihai, Saturn transgressed the Celestial Pass.
idiomatic: Jihai: Saturn crossed the Celestial Pass.

literal: The prognostication states: "Ministers will plot against the ruler."
idiomatic: Ministerial treason is portended.

literal: In the eighth month, the Great White transgressed the second southern star of the Chamber.
idiomatic: August: Venus crossed the Chamber’s second south star.

literal: On day Bingzi in the eleventh month, the Great White transgressed the Weeping star.
idiomatic: November, bingzi: Venus crossed the Weeping star.

literal: That seventh month, Zhu Lingshi took Shu.
idiomatic: That July Zhu Lingshi conquered Shu.

literal: Shu rebelled again and was campaigned against and destroyed.
idiomatic: Shu rose once more and was suppressed.

literal: In the eighth year, seventh month, day Guihai, the moon covered the second northern star of the Chamber.
idiomatic: Eighth year, July, guihai: the Moon occulted the Chamber’s second north star.

literal: On day Jiwei, the moon transgressed the Well’s battle-axe.
idiomatic: Jiwei: the Moon crossed the Eastern Well’s axe stars.

literal: On day Wushen in the eighth month, the moon transgressed the Sobbing star.
idiomatic: August, wushen: the Moon crossed the Sobbing star.

literal: On day Xinhai in the tenth month, the moon covered the Celestial Pass.
idiomatic: October, xinhai: the Moon occulted the Celestial Pass.

literal: The prognostication states: "There will be arms."
idiomatic: War follows.

literal: On day Dingchou in the eleventh month, Saturn transgressed the Eastern Well.
idiomatic: November, dingchou: Saturn crossed the Eastern Well.

literal: The prognostication states: "Great men will grieve."
idiomatic: High lords face mourning.

literal: On day Guimao in the twelfth month, Saturn transgressed the Well’s battle-axe.
idiomatic: December, guimao: Saturn crossed the Well’s axe stars.

literal: In that year’s eighth month, Empress Wang died.
idiomatic: That August Empress Wang died.

literal: In the ninth month, Liu Fan and Xie Hun were executed and Liu Yi was campaigned against and destroyed.
idiomatic: September: Liu Fan and Xie Hun were killed while Liu Yi’s faction was crushed.

literal: In the twelfth month, Zhu Lingshi extinguished Shu.
idiomatic: December: Zhu Lingshi finished the Shu pacification.

literal: In the ninth year’s second month, Mars entered the Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: Ninth year, February: Mars entered the Ghost asterism.

literal: The prognostication states: "There will be arms and mourning."
idiomatic: War and funerals coincide.

literal: The Great White transgressed the South River.
idiomatic: Venus crossed the South River stars.

literal: The prognostication states: "Arms will arise."
idiomatic: War stirs.

literal: On day Renchen in the fifth month, the Great White transgressed the Right Law Enforcer and was seen in daytime.
idiomatic: May, renchen: Venus crossed the Right Law Enforcer and shone by day.

literal: On day Gengwu in the seventh month, the moon covered the Hook-and-Hasp.
idiomatic: July, gengwu: the Moon occulted the Hook-and-Hasp.

literal: The prognostication states: "Throat-and-tongue ministers will grieve."
idiomatic: Court spokesmen face ruin.

literal: On day Gengwu in the ninth month, Jupiter transgressed the great star of the Coachman.
idiomatic: September, gengwu: Jupiter crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star.

literal: On day Jichou, the moon transgressed the left Horn.
idiomatic: Jichou: the Moon crossed the left Horn.

literal: At the time Liu Yu monopolized commands and arms never rested.
idiomatic: Liu Yu held unchecked power while wars rolled on.

literal: In the tenth year, Yu campaigned against Sima Xiuzhi.
idiomatic: Year ten: Liu Yu struck Sima Xiuzhi.

literal: The royal army did not prevail; Xiuzhi and others fled to Chang’an.
idiomatic: Imperial forces lost; Xiuzhi’s party bolted to Chang’an.

literal: In the tenth year, first month, day Dingmao, the moon transgressed the Net.
idiomatic: Tenth year, first month, dingmao: the Moon crossed the Net.

literal: The prognostication states: "Generals and ministers will have someone who by the image seat is punished."
idiomatic: High command faces punishment matching the stellar seat.

literal: On day Jiyou in the second month, the moon transgressed the northern star of the Chamber.
idiomatic: February, jiyou: the Moon crossed the Chamber’s north star.

literal: On day Renyin in the fifth month, the moon transgressed the southern star of the Oxherd.
idiomatic: May, renyin: the Moon crossed the Oxherd’s southern star.

literal: On day Yichou, Jupiter transgressed the great star of the Coachman.
idiomatic: Yichou: Jupiter crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star.

literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
idiomatic: Glosses matched earlier Coachman omens.

literal: On day Bingshen in the sixth month, the moon covered the Root.
idiomatic: June, bingshen: the Moon occulted the Root.

literal: The prognostication states: "A general will die for it; the state will have executions."
idiomatic: A commander dies while the court orders killings.

literal: On day Gengchen in the seventh month, the moon transgressed the Celestial Pass.
idiomatic: July, gengchen: the Moon crossed the Celestial Pass.

literal: The prognostication states: "Arms will arise."
idiomatic: War is portended.

literal: Mars transgressed the Well’s battle-axe.
idiomatic: Mars crossed the Well’s axe stars.

literal: Saturn transgressed the Ghost Cart and then guarded it.
idiomatic: Saturn crossed the Ghost asterism and stationed there.

literal: The prognostication states: "Great men will grieve; the ancestral temples will change."
idiomatic: Mourning among magnates and dynastic upheaval.

literal: On day Dingyou in the eighth month, the moon covered the southern star of the Oxherd.
idiomatic: August, dingyou: the Moon occulted the Oxherd’s southern star.

literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
idiomatic: Same gloss as the prior Oxherd omen.

literal: In the ninth month, Saturn transgressed the Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: September: Saturn crossed the Ghost asterism.

literal: The prognostication states: "The ruler will be anxious."
idiomatic: The sovereign faces dread.

literal: On day Dingsi, the Great White entered the Feathered Forest.
idiomatic: Dingsi: Venus entered the Feathered Forest.

literal: On day Jiyou in the twelfth month, the moon transgressed the western Sincerity.
idiomatic: December, jiyou: the Moon crossed western Sincerity.

literal: The prognostication states: "There will be secret plots."
idiomatic: Hidden intrigue spreads.

literal: In the eleventh year, Linyi raided Jiaozhou and was resisted and defeated.
idiomatic: Year eleven: Linyi struck Jiaozhou and was beaten back.

literal: In the eleventh year, third month, day Dingsi, the moon entered the Net.
idiomatic: Eleventh year, March, dingsi: the Moon entered the Net.

literal: The prognostication states: "Under Heaven arms will arise."
idiomatic: Realm-wide war follows.

literal: One gloss says: "There will be border troops."
idiomatic: A variant stresses frontier hosts.

literal: On day Jimao, Mars entered the Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: Jimao: Mars entered the Ghost asterism.

literal: On day Bingwu in the intercalary month, Saturn again entered the Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: Leap month, bingwu: Saturn re-entered the Ghost asterism.

literal: The prognostication states: "There will be drought, great pestilence, and rebellious ministers."
idiomatic: Drought, plague, and treasonous officials follow.

literal: On day Guimao in the fifth month, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
idiomatic: May, guimao: Mars entered the Supreme Palace.

literal: On day Jiachen, it transgressed the Right Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: Jiachen: Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer.

literal: On day Jiwei in the sixth month, the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.
idiomatic: June, jiwei: Venus crossed the Eastern Well.

literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms."
idiomatic: Qin-zone warfare again.

literal: On day Wuyin, it transgressed the Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: Wuyin: Venus crossed the Ghost asterism.

literal: The prognostication states: "The state will have grief."
idiomatic: National mourning.

literal: On day Xinchou in the seventh month, the moon transgressed the Net.
idiomatic: July, xinchou: the Moon crossed the Net.

literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
idiomatic: Same Net gloss as before.

literal: On day Renzi in the eighth month, the moon transgressed the Root.
idiomatic: August, renzi: the Moon crossed the Root.

literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
idiomatic: Same Root gloss as before.

literal: On day Gengshen, the Great White moved direct, entering the Supreme Palace Enclosure from the right Censor Gate.
idiomatic: Gengshen: Venus moved direct into the enclosure through the right rear gate.

literal: On day Dingmao, it covered the Left Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: Dingmao: Venus occulted the Left Law Enforcer.

literal: On day Guihai in the eleventh month, the moon entered the Net.
idiomatic: November, guihai: the Moon entered the Net.

literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
idiomatic: Same Net entry gloss.

literal: On day Yiwei, the moon entered the Ghost Cart and showed a halo.
idiomatic: Yiwei: the Moon entered the Ghost asterism with a lunar halo.

literal: In the twelfth year, fifth month, day Jiashen, Jupiter halted between the Chamber and the Heart, the field allotment of Song.
idiomatic: Twelfth year, May, jiashen: Jupiter stationed between House and Heart, Song’s celestial field.
